title: Anthony Zurcher: Democrats push deep into Republican territory with historic wins
description: Two Senate races that a year ago were thought to be battlegrounds turned out to be slam-dunks for the Democrats.

title: South Carolina elects Democratic senator for first time in almost three decades
description: Annie Andrews is projected to defeat Darline Graham, who was handpicked by President Trump to take her brother's seat after his death.

title: When will we know who wins control of Congress?
description: The first polls have closed, but it is possible the results will not be projected for several hours, days or even weeks.

title: Democratic rising star Ossoff projected to hold Georgia seat
description: Ossoff is seen as a potential leading contender for the Democratic nomination for president in 2028 if he throws his hat in the ring.

title: Miliband says slavery apology will not bring cost for UK taxpayers
description: Speaking to BBC's Newscast, the foreign secretary says Britain cannot sweep its past "under the carpet".

title: 'Multi-cancer' blood tests coming to some GP surgeries soon
description: The aim is to detect hard-to-diagnose abdominal cancers, including liver, ovarian and pancreatic cancer, much sooner.

title: Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash
description: At least 69 people were killed and dozens injured in the collision south of the capital, Madrid.

title: Celebrity loses injunction bid but will stay anonymous pending appeal
description: The unnamed man asked for an injunction to stop his identity being reported in connection with allegations against him.

title: No more rice grains in Kellogg's Rice Krispies due to changing weather
description: The new recipes mean cereal packaging will now include a 'contains wheat gluten' warning.
